queries_run: AbbVie Skyrizi Rinvoq market share 2026 competition Humira biosimilar

findings.claim: 10-K 指出 Humira 面臨全球直接生物相似藥競爭，免疫產品與 IL-23、IL-17、JAK 抑制劑競爭，腫瘤產品與 BTK 抑制劑、ADC、細胞療法競爭。
findings.excerpt: AbbVie's immunology products compete with IL-23 inhibitors, IL-17 inhibitors, JAK inhibitors, biosimilars and other competitive products intended to treat a number of disease states, and AbbVie's oncology products compete with targeted therapies including BTK inhibitors, ADCs, cell therapies and other competitive products intended to treat certain cancers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：專利到期後生物相似藥／學名藥會在短時間內顯著侵蝕銷售，且大型藥廠與學名藥廠持續跨入生物相似藥。
findings.excerpt: The expiration or loss of patent protection for a product typically is followed promptly by substitutes that may significantly reduce sales for that product in a short amount of time.

findings.claim: Skyrizi 取得美國乾癬總處方份額逾 45%，IBD 一線 in-play 病患擷取率 75%（Crohn's 80%）；Rinvoq RA in-play 份額中段十位數。
findings.source: Motley Fool AbbVie Q4 2025 earnings call transcript
findings.excerpt: SKYRIZI market share (US psoriasis) -- Secured over 45% total prescription share, while frontline in-play patient capture rate in US IBD has reached 75% overall and 80% in Crohn's disease.

note: 搜尋摘要提到 Skyrizi 美國乾癬處方份額>45%、Rinvoq 中段十位數份額（Q4 2025 財報電話會議摘要）、Tremfya 與口服 IL-23 icotrokinra 為競爭風險；僅有聚合站摘要，未取得逐字原文，列為線索。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
